clips.title: The story
paras: In Gnomeregan, the Prismatic Punch Card carries the highest security clearance. Gnome refugees in Ironforge seek the records it unlocks.

When the gnomes fled Gnomeregan, troggs and toxic irradiation drove them from their city. Vast stores of research and civic records remained in its depths. The gnomes guarded high-level systems with rising levels of clearance. To reach the Matrix Punchograph 3005-D in the lower Engineering Labs, a card must pass through a series of terminals. It starts white, then advances through yellow, blue, and red before the final terminal stamps it Prismatic. The card's encoded clearance is listed as awaiting the invention of an entirely new number.
